description: This file defines an Angular service called AuthService that provides in-memory authentication functionality, including login and logout methods, with a simple demo user setup.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A minimal in-memory authentication service for demo/testing purposes implementing login and logout functionality.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Simulates an asynchronous login, checks credentials against a demo user, updates authentication state, and resolves success or failure.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current user by setting the authentication state to false.

ctags.name: ok
ctags.pattern: /^        const ok = email === this.user.email && password === this.user.password;$/

ctags.name: timer
ctags.pattern: /^      const timer: (handler: () => void, timeout?: number) => number =$/
